question: Which dance guru of Kuchipudi dance got Padma Bhushan in 1998?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam** was a legendary Kuchipudi dance guru who played a pivotal role in popularizing this classical dance form globally.
 
• He received the prestigious **Padma Bhushan award in 1998** for his exceptional contribution to Indian classical dance.
 
• Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam founded the **Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai** in 1963 to preserve and promote Kuchipudi dance traditions.
 
• He choreographed numerous iconic Kuchipudi ballets, including **“Srinivasa Kalyanam”** and **“Rukmini Kalyanam,”** which became milestones in the evolution of the dance form.
 
• His unique teaching style and efforts brought recognition to Kuchipudi as one of the eight major classical dance forms of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi Dance:** It is a classical dance form originating from Andhra Pradesh and is known for its graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive gestures.
 
• **Padma Bhushan Award:** It is the third-highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• **Guru Vempati’s Legacy:** His contributions include reviving Kuchipudi dance dramas and adapting them for modern stages while maintaining their classical essence.
 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India:** Besides Kuchipudi, India is home to other classical dance forms like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Manipuri, Kathakali, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
 
• **Notable Students:** Many renowned Kuchipudi dancers, such as Shantala Shivalingappa, owe their training and success to Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam’s guidance.
